changelog:
**Initial release of paper2slides: Instantly transform academic papers into professional slide decks.**

- New name and streamlined functionality focused on one-step PDF-to-slides conversion.
- Added support for multiple output formats: HTML/CSS, Marp Markdown, and PPTX.
- Simplified user commands with options for theme, language, and slide focus.
- Introduced auto-structured slide outlines to adapt to different paper lengths and styles.
- Removed legacy documentation and prompt templates for a leaner workflow.
- Now includes clearer instructions, user-invokable interface, and enhanced multilingual support.
summary: Transform any academic paper PDF into a polished presentation slide deck
